messages:
Ravi: Idea for next month: a short "refapp workshop" campaign aimed at developers — 3 artifacts: tiny code-first tutorial, reproducible micro-bench, and a 25-min live lab/demo. Goal: repo stars + qualified leads.
Cass: Nice. Suggest we make the tutorial single-file runnable (one script) so folks can clone & run in <10m. Add a `Makefile` and Dockerfile.
Noor: I'll draft the bench plan: measure p50/p95, tokens/sec, GPU mem, and cost-per-1k-tokens across small/medium models. Include a one-command harness.
Diego: Ops note: need landing page with UTM params, HubSpot form, and a follow-up email flow. Also set tag = refapp_workshop on submission.
Ravi: Owners: Cass -> tutorial + repo scaffolding, Noor -> bench + CI job, Diego -> landing + email + lead-routing. I'll handle webinar schedule and newsletter slot.
Cass: Tutorial outline: 1) Clone + run (5m) 2) Add batching & cache (10m) 3) Swap to Private deploy (10m). Each step has code + GIF.
Noor: Bench CLI example (to land in repo):
```bash
python bench.py --model redwood-base --seq 1024 --batch 8 --metrics p50,p95,toks_per_sec --out bench.csv
```
Noor: Also will add a small `bench/configs` folder with presets so community can reproduce with TPU/GPU variations.
Diego: Lead routing rules: if company_size >= 100 OR interest contains "private" -> assign to enterprise-sdr. Else -> nurture drip 3 emails. Also push event to Amplitude: event = "refapp_signup".
Ravi: Messaging angle: two strands — "build in minutes" for dev channels, and "save on inference costs" for mailing list/enterprise. We'll A/B subject lines on the sign-up form.
Cass: Social copy candidates:
- "Hands-on: run a tiny inference refapp in 10 minutes + live lab. Join: https://rwd.in/refapp_lab #opensource #mlops"
- "See real inference numbers — join our live lab where we run benchmarks and deploy. https://rwd.in/refapp_lab"
Diego: Webinar logistics: 25min demo + 15min Q&A. Need a short sled (one-liner) for the registration form and a checkbox for "interested in dedicated/private deployment".
Noor: CI: add a nightly bench run that posts results to `bench-results/` in the repo. That will let us show a trend in the benchmark blog.
Ravi: Timeline: Week A: repo + tutorial draft; Week B: bench script + landing page; Week C: publish blog + open signups; Week D: webinar + follow-ups.
Diego: I'll make the HubSpot form today and drop the embed code in the repo README.
Cass: Can we package a small "lab task" in the repo for community night? e.g., swap batch size and report p95. Good for engagement.
Ravi: Yes. Add a `lab.md` with 3 short tasks and expected outputs. We'll promote it as "Bring your laptop" material.
ops-bot: Reminder: create tracking UTMs and GA event names by 2026-07-05.
Diego: Quick check: do we need legal review for the workshop dataset? it's tiny public text, but want to be safe.
Noor: It's public CC0 snippets, fine, but will add attribution in README.
Ravi: Great. Cass and Noor, please make initial PRs by EOD Friday. Diego, ping when the form is live so we can test routing. :thumbsup:
Cass: on it.
Noor: PR incoming.
Diego: Form up, dropping link in thread. https://hubspot.example/forms/refapp-workshop
Ravi: Thanks team. We'll iterate messaging after first 48h of signups.
